# Signal

## Problem

Product teams lose signal when the same request is filed many times under different words.

## Who

Submitters (customers filing requests) and the product team triaging them. Agent users: none.

## Commitments

- The submitter chooses whether to upvote a suggested match or post a new request. Signal never merges requests on its own.

## Main metric

Duplicate rate: share of new requests a triager later marks duplicate, per board, per month. Baseline 31% (manual count, September). Target: hypothesis, no target yet.

## Core journeys

- Submit a request, see suggested matches, upvote one or post.
- Triage the week's new requests.
